primary_interest.quote: We want to replace our IVR with voice AI agents.

use_case.quote: We want to replace our IVR with voice AI agents.

edge_framing.quote: Our edge compute runs the functions your agent calls, close to the caller, as part of the voice agent.

edge_raised_by.quote: We've been trying Cloudflare Workers for that part. Is that something you handle, or would we keep it separate?

competitors_edge.quote: We've been trying Cloudflare Workers for that part.

competitors_voice.quote: We've been testing with Vapi for a couple of months.

decision_criteria.quote: So call completion matters a lot to me. If the call drops halfway through a rebooking, that's worse than the old IVR. And voice quality, too.

stated_reason.quote: Time to first token, how quickly the agent starts speaking after the person stops. If there's a long silence, people talk over it and the whole thing falls apart.
